name: emil-design-eng
title_zh: 让按钮按下去那一下就觉得贵的界面打磨清单
tagline_zh: 你的功能都做完了，可界面还是像半成品：间距忽宽忽窄、悬停没有反馈、弹窗硬生生蹦出来。
tagline_en: Your features are done but the UI still feels unfinished: uneven spacing, no hover feedback, modals that just.
desc_en: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.
why_zh: 它不讲配色理论，只给判断：这个动效该不该加、这段过渡多长才不腻、哪一处留白在偷偷拉低质感。
why_en: No color theory. Just calls: whether this animation earns its place, how long a transition stays tasteful, which gap is quietly.
limit_zh: 是审美判断清单，不是组件库：不产出代码、不指定框架，React/Vue/原生都得自己落地。
limit_en: A taste checklist, not a component library: no code, no framework, no Figma file. Teams with a mature design system will find most items already done.
title_en: UI polish checklist that makes buttons feel expensive
